rounds.q: What % of US flights arrive on time?
rounds.why: On time means arriving less than 15 minutes late. In 2025 about 3 in 4 flights managed it.
rounds.src: US Bureau of Transportation Statistics, On-Time Performance (2025 data)
rounds.fun: About 3 in 4 flights make it on time. Under 15 minutes late still counts!

rounds.q: What % of US adults have ever flown on a plane?
rounds.why: Only 45% flew in 2025, and back in 1977 just 63% had ever flown.
rounds.src: Airlines for America / Ipsos, Air Travelers in America survey (Jan 2026, 3,847 adults)
rounds.fun: 87% have flown at least once, up from 63% in 1977. The sky got busier!

rounds.q: How many seconds did the Wright brothers' first flight last?
rounds.why: It covered 120 feet. The best flight that same day lasted 59 seconds and went 852 feet.
rounds.src: Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum, 1903 Wright Flyer (Dec 17, 1903)
rounds.fun: Just 12 seconds and 120 feet. Short hop, giant start!

rounds.q: For every 1,000 airline passengers, how many bags get lost, late or damaged?
rounds.why: About 24 million bags were mishandled among 5 billion passengers worldwide in 2025.
rounds.fun: Only about 5 in 1,000. Odds are your suitcase makes the trip with you!

rounds.q: How many million passengers used the world's busiest airport in 2025?
rounds.why: Atlanta kept the top spot with 106.3 million. Dubai was second with 95.2 million.
rounds.src: Airports Council International World, final 2025 airport traffic rankings (July 2026)
rounds.fun: Atlanta welcomed 106.3 million passengers, beating Dubai by about 11 million!
